newsitem.title: UK: Insurer Hardy Underwriting on London's AIM.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Hardy Underwriting on London's AIM.

text.p: Lloyd's insurance company Hardy Underwriting Group Plc (HUG) said it had been admitted to London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
The placing of 7.3 million shares, by way of an introduction at 145 pence per share, capitalises the group at around 10.65 million stg prior to the full conversion of loan stock in 1999.
Dealings began today, and the share was quoted at 150 pence, although no trade had been reported by 1020 GMT.
The acquisition of Lloyd's syndicate Hardy (Underwriting Agencies) Ltd (HUA) by HUG was agreed at an extraordinary general meeting on December 20.
HUA is the managing agent of Lloyd's insurance Syndicate 382 which writes a spread of business across the marine, aviation and non-marine markets, but specialises in helicopters.
HUG will provide up to 16 million stg of capacity for syndicate 382 in 1997, almost 25 percent of the syndicate's total capacity.

"We have met our objectives for 1996, being an increase in size by involving both existing names through an offer of shares, as well as buying capacity through Lloyd's Auction," said HUG chief executive Peter Hardy.
"Listing on AIM brings the vital ingredient of allowing liquidity, valuation and public exposure," added Hardy, who has been the active underwriter for syndicate 382 since it was set up in 1975.
